phylogeny_controls_post_hoc.status: post-hoc diagnostic analyses, not inputs to the deployed predictor

uses_real_labels.genus_level_accuracy: real genus labels (first word of the curated species name) define the target
uses_real_labels.genus_mean_residualization: training samples are grouped by their real genus label to subtract group means
uses_real_labels.within_genus_analysis: real genus labels partition samples into same-genus subsets

unsupervised_component.tree_pc_residualization: principal axes of host FCGR are learned without labels; the label is used only to index a phage's host

phylogeny_controls_post_hoc.no_deployment_leakage: the deployed BMKMPHI pipeline consumes only sequence-derived features (FCGR and pyrodigal protein coding features); genus labels, genus means and within-genus partitions are never available at prediction time and never enter the training inputs of the deployed model
phylogeny_controls_post_hoc.purpose: these analyses diagnose whether the codon/coding signal is explained by shared ancestry; they do not report a deployable accuracy
phylogeny_controls_post_hoc.caveat: residualized and within-genus numbers must be read as conditional, label-dependent diagnostics rather than generalization performance
